dedupe_keys.name: trafficdata se swedish national access point for traffic and road network data

description: Trafficdata.se is a national service, provided by the Swedish Transport Administration, that gathers information on and gives access to traffic and road network data in Sweden, whichever organisation collects and supplies them. It is aimed both at data providers, who publish metadata, and at users building information services, who reach the data through links to each supplier. It offers manuals in English and Swedish, and its CKAN catalogue API reported 50 datasets on 2026-09-29. Coverage: the Swedish road network. Format and access: a CKAN metadata catalogue with links to suppliers. Licence and cost: free to browse; terms per dataset. Caveats: the portal holds metadata, not the data. It supports network flow and emergency response studies in Sweden. It relates to the Trafikverket open API, the EU list of national access points and DATEX II in the catalogue.
name: Trafficdata.se: Swedish national access point for traffic and road network data
